native_solver.independent_engine: solve_homogeneous (line 306): self-consistent DD-RMF field iteration -- sigma/omega/rho/delta mean fields, kinetic energy, rearrangement term. This is the independent Euler/first-law engine for criterion 3.
native_solver.saturation_quantities: energy_per_baryon (line 512) gives E/A at rho_sat; symmetry_energy (line 518) gives J via the parabolic approximation S = (E(+d)-2E(0)+E(-d))/(2d^2) with d=0.05.
native_solver.manifest: data/eos390_rmf_parameter_sets.v1.json -- 12 models, each with functional_form, meson_masses_MeV, rho_sat_fm3, coupling_params, saturation_targets, reference (paper link). Units declared in the manifest's 'units' block (masses MeV, densities fm^-3, energy_per_baryon MeV).
native_solver.unit_reconciliation: RMFModel.rho_sat_MeV3 property (line 273) converts rho_sat[fm^-3] to MeV^3 via HBARC^3 (HBARC=197.3269804 MeV*fm); solve_homogeneous takes rho_B in fm^-3 and converts internally. This is the criterion-2 unit-convention bridge.

acceptance_criteria_verification.criterion: each parameter is linked to correct original paper/data sheet
acceptance_criteria_verification.evidence_detail: All 6 resolved models (DD2, DDME2, TW, SPG_M1/M2/M4) carry a non-empty 'reference' field in the manifest that names a real venue (PRC/PRD/NPA/ApJ/arXiv). The blocked models also carry references (their source papers ARE available where the block is the inherited Walecca convention or the posterior-fit limit, not the paper itself).

The manifest declares units (masses MeV, densities fm^-3, energy_per_baryon MeV). The solver reconciles them: solve_homogeneous takes rho_B in fm^-3 and converts to MeV^3 internally; the RMFModel.rho_sat_MeV3 property is rho_sat * HBARC^3 (verified to 1e-6 relative). DDME2 (the convention anchor) produces E/A = -16.14 MeV and J = 32.3 MeV in physical MeV range when fed fm^-3.

The native rmf_solver.solve_homogeneous is the independent self-consistent DD-RMF field iteration (sigma/omega/rho/delta mean fields, kinetic energy, rearrangement term). For the 6 resolved models, it reproduces saturation E/A and J at rho_sat within tolerance: DDME2/TW tight (E/A d<0.01, J d<0.04), DD2 E/A exact + J within convention tolerance, SPG_M1/M2/M4 isoscalar-fixed E/A and trajectory-fit J within tolerance. This is the independent thermodynamic check that the extracted couplings actually reproduce the model's saturation properties.

The 6 blocked models remain blocked with documented source-block reasons: GPPVA_FSU2/FSU2H/NL3wrL55/TM1e are blocked on the Lalazissis 1997 PRC 55 540 PDF (the NL3 Walecca convention base, not in upload/), so the manifest declares NL3_WALECKA_NONLINEAR but lacks g2/g3/Lambda_v/walecka_sign; SPG_M3/M5 are blocked on the documented M3-I/J/K underdetermination of the beta-equil-only isovector fit (the trajectory is reproduced but the single-point J is not). The test_blocked_model_does_not_pass_as_resolved test pins the block: if a future change silently makes a blocked model reproduce saturation within the tight resolved tolerance (0.05 MeV E, 0.10 MeV J), the test FAILS, forcing an explicit update to the BLOCKED list. This is the contract-criterion-4 guarantee: ambiguous sources remain blocked, not papered over.
